topics.name: Memory Retrieval Context
topics.purpose: Define retrieval from `#MEM` as an explicit bounded context projection with exact record refs, ranking/filter evidence and no hidden ambient memory injection.

semantics.result_rule: Retrieved context contains exact memory-record refs.
semantics.ranking_rule: Ranking/relevance method/profile is explicit where machine-significant.
semantics.bound_rule: Result count/token/size/time scope is explicitly bounded.
semantics.context_rule: Retrieved records are projected into model/tool context as inert data.
semantics.hidden_rule: No undeclared memory source is silently injected into a governed q-family context.
semantics.authority_rule: Retrieval success does not grant access to referenced resources beyond separately authorized projection.

invariants.rule: Memory and retrieved context are provenance-bearing inert data projections; remembered or retrieved content never becomes authority, canonical truth or executable instruction merely by inclusion in context.

references.purpose: q-family context uses explicit memory projection.
